name: Hazel Brugger
bio:
Hazel Brugger is an award-winning stand-up comedian and presenter. She was born in the United States and grew up in Zurich before relocating to Germany's Darmstadt region.

She has won the German Comedy Award, the Salzburg Bull, and the Swiss Comedy Award. She was dubbed "the queen of wit" by the German Kleinkunstpreis jury.
